reason: Narrows migration method return-type matching from a loose 'has GetAwaiter' check to exact Task<int>/int types, which only formalizes what already worked (other awaitable types would have thrown InvalidCastException before too) but touches core migration invocation logic used by every module's Create/UpdateFrom* methods.
